summary: First full E2E test of Sistema de Licitações. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passing across auth, lists, bids CRUD, dashboard summary, budget ERP with execution financial propagation, Adjudicado->execution auto-create (incl. idempotency), execution KPIs + step/status sync, preferences/company, file upload. Frontend: login, sidebar navigation, dashboard summary cards, Nova Licitação modal validation, status dropdown -> Adjudicado, execution auto-population, 10-step timeline, ERP global cards, settings 5 tabs all confirmed working via UI. Two functional issues identified in the ERP mutual-exclusion flow.

ui_bugs.issue: After user types VALOR VENDA (which sets row.mode='venda' and makes MARGEM readOnly), clearing the VALOR VENDA field does NOT reset row.mode, so MARGEM remains readonly and the user cannot switch to margem-driven mode. PRD says mutual exclusion should let typing in margem clear venda. The current one-way readOnly lock blocks the inverse direction.

issues: Date validation error 'Não é permitida data retroativa' shows correctly but the Save button stays disabled with no field-level error toast/indicator until user blurs the field. UX could improve by showing inline validation states once user attempts to save.

action_items: Fix Budget ERP mutual-exclusion: when VALOR VENDA is cleared (empty/0), reset row.mode so the user can edit MARGEM to switch into margem-driven mode (and symmetrically vice-versa). Currently mode='venda' is set on typing venda but never reverted, leaving MARGEM permanently readonly for that row.
Consider showing inline validation errors in Nova Licitação modal proactively (not only after blur) so users understand why Salvar is disabled.
critical_code_review_comments: Budget.jsx readOnly={r.mode === 'venda'} on margem input creates one-way lock; should be cleared when valor_venda becomes empty.
BidFormModal: data_disputa validation uses ISO string compare ok, but errors are gated behind `touched[k]`; consider running validation on submit attempt to surface why save is disabled.
Dashboard testid is 'card-mes' but the original PRD references 'card-licitacoes-mes' verbally; OK as long as consistent.

All MongoDB objectId leaks correctly avoided (responses use 'id', not '_id'). Async/await used properly. Bearer auth enforced on /me. CORS appears configured (frontend loads via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
Bid favorite endpoint expects {favorito: bool} body - good; status change endpoint correctly triggers _ensure_execution and is idempotent (verified by test_idempotent_adjudicado).
Budget save propagation to execution record verified end-to-end: valor_total->valor_empenho, custo_global->valor_compra, lucro_global->lucro_previsto.
Settings.jsx tabs rendering: all 5 TabsTriggers rendered together via Radix; works as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (1 functional bug in ERP mutual-exclusion; everything else works)

test_credentials: admin@licita.com / admin123 (seeded admin, JWT Bearer token in /api/auth/login response)
seed_data_creation: Created test bids/budget/execution during tests; all TEST_-prefixed bids cleaned up at end via DELETE /api/bids/{id}. One TEST_EMPRESA LTDA was written to company prefs (single-doc) - non-disruptive but main agent may want to reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v). Container date is 2026-05-31 - use future dates (e.g., 2026-06-15) when filling bid date in Nova Licitação modal. All 5 settings tabs exist (testids: tab-perfil, tab-empresa, tab-aparencia, tab-orcamento, tab-listas). Dashboard summary card testid for 'Licitações do Mês' is `card-mes` (NOT card-licitacoes-mes). The Adjudicado status option appears in a Radix DropdownMenu portal; locator works fine with data-testid `status-option-{bidId}-Adjudicado`. After PATCH /api/bids/{id}/status to Adjudicado, an execution record is auto-created and budget summary fields propagate financially.
rca_of_the_issue: ERP mutual-exclusion bug RCA: In Budget.jsx, typing into VALOR VENDA calls onVenda which sets row.mode='venda' and clears row.margem; the MARGEM input then renders with readOnly={r.mode==='venda'}. However, clearing the VALOR VENDA field does NOT reset r.mode back to null/auto, so MARGEM stays readonly indefinitely. Fix: in onVenda, when value becomes empty/0, reset r.mode (e.g., r.mode=null); similarly in onMargem when margem is cleared, reset r.mode='venda'-equivalent or null so the inputs can swap modes. Reproduction: ERP → type venda=1500 (margem auto-calcs, readonly) → clear venda field → try to type margem → element not editable.
